{{Quote|I need a man, a daring soul with unlimited guts to get my useless bones the heck off-world.''"<br />"''I'm that man. Even come with a ship.|Braxas and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SW89" />}}
This '''shuttle''' was a [[Starship/Legends|craft]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for diplomatic missions.

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used this shuttle to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solay]]. After fighting in the [[Battle of Solay]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet moved in and blockaded the planet, suppressing all rebel activity. However, Skywalker was able to bypass the blockade, outflying the rebel ships to escape Solay. Skywalker brought along the local [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Braxas]] with him in exchange for information about the conclusion of the earlier battle.<ref name="SW89" />
